wallet.title: Your Wallet

chainDescriptions.bitcoin: The original and most well-known cryptocurrency. Transfers typically confirm in around half an hour.
chainDescriptions.ethereum: Works well for regular transfers and widely supported everywhere. Usually confirms within under a minute, with small fees.
chainDescriptions.solana: Best when you want things to move fast. Transfers finish almost instantly and cost less than a cent.
chainDescriptions.usdc: Digital dollars. 1 USDC ≈ $1. Arrives on your Solana address. Fast and costs less than a cent.

wallet.filteredExplainer: Two kinds of transactions land here. Dust spam: tiny incoming transfers attackers use to trick you into copying the wrong address. And system activity: the small network fee paid on the chain's native asset when you send a token (for example, the few lamports of SOL that go out with every USDC send). They are real on-chain, but not something you initiated or need to act on.

importSeed.title: Import Seed Phrase
importSeed.description: Already have a wallet? Bring your seed phrase to get a nimimo identity and link your existing addresses.
importSeed.disclaimerIntro: We generally recommend creating a fresh nimimo identity instead of importing an existing seed. A new identity is safer because:
importSeed.disclaimerReason1: Typing or pasting a seed phrase carries risk even on a trusted device
importSeed.disclaimerReason2: Your seed may already be used in another wallet - sharing keys across platforms increases exposure
importSeed.disclaimerReason3: A fresh nimimo identity gives you a clean start with full recovery support
importSeed.disclaimerOutro: That said, if you understand the risks and want to link your existing addresses to a nimimo @handle, you can proceed. Your seed phrase is encrypted locally and never sent to our servers.
importSeed.seedPhrasePlaceholder: Type or paste your 12 or 24-word seed phrase…
importSeed.compatibilityNote: Compatible with any 12 or 24 word recovery phrase (BIP-39 standard). Your seed phrase is encrypted and stored only on this device.
importSeed.invalidMnemonic: Invalid seed phrase. The words or their order may be incorrect. BIP-39 seed phrases have a built-in checksum - not every combination of words is valid.

install.metaTitle: Install nimimo - one-tap shortcut for your phone
install.metaDescription: Install nimimo on your iPhone or desktop as a one-tap shortcut. No app store, no download - just a browser shortcut that opens full-screen like a native app.
install.pageDescription: Get nimimo as a one-tap shortcut on your home screen or desktop. No app store, no download - the browser just saves a shortcut that opens nimimo full-screen like a native app. One tap, no typing, no scrolling through search results.

warning.title: Back up your identity first
warning.body: The installed shortcut has its own storage, separate from the browser you installed it from. Your current identity won't automatically carry over - you'll need your recovery file to restore it inside the app. Make sure you've downloaded one before you install.

iphone.heading: iPhone & iPad (Safari)
iphone.intro: It has to be Safari - other iOS browsers (Chrome, Brave, Firefox) don't support installing web apps on iOS because Apple restricts that capability to Safari.
iphone.step2: Tap the Share button (<icon></icon>) at the bottom of the screen.
iphone.step3: Scroll down and tap <highlight>Add to Home Screen</highlight>.
iphone.step4: Tap <highlight>Add</highlight> in the top right. The nimimo icon appears on your home screen.

desktop.heading: Desktop (Chrome, Edge, Safari)
desktop.intro: On desktop the shortcut lives in your dock, taskbar, or app launcher and opens in its own window - no browser tabs, no address bar.
desktop.step1: Open nimimo.com in Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
desktop.step2: In <highlight>Chrome</highlight> or <highlight>Edge</highlight>: look for the install icon on the right side of the address bar and click it. Or use the menu → <highlight>Install nimimo</highlight>.
desktop.step3: In <highlight>Safari on macOS</highlight>: File → <highlight>Add to Dock</highlight>.
desktop.step4: Confirm. nimimo appears in your dock / taskbar and opens in its own window from now on.

after.heading: After you install
after.body: Tap the nimimo icon on your home screen. If the app opens to a sign-in screen instead of your existing identity, that's expected - the installed shortcut has its own storage. Sign in with Google, then import your recovery file to pull your identity into the app.
